descriptions.zh-CN: 降低场上除自己外所有宝可梦的防御。

descriptions.en-US: Lowers Attack of all Pokémon except itself.
descriptions.zh-CN: 降低场上除自己外所有宝可梦的攻击。

descriptions.en-US: Lowers Special Defense of all Pokémon except itself.
descriptions.zh-CN: 降低场上除自己外所有宝可梦的特防。

descriptions.en-US: Turns the sunlight harsh when entering battle, and boosts Attack while active.
descriptions.zh-CN: 出场时形成晴天，并在晴天下提高自己的攻击。

descriptions.en-US: Creates an Electric Terrain when entering battle, and boosts Special Attack while active.
descriptions.zh-CN: 出场时形成电气场地，并在电气场地下提高自己的特攻。

descriptions.en-US: Copies stat boosts by the opponent.
descriptions.zh-CN: 对手提高能力时，会复制相同的能力变化。

descriptions.en-US: Causes the Pokémon to reuse an already consumed Berry at the end of the next turn.
descriptions.zh-CN: 吃掉树果后的下一回合结束时，会再次获得该树果的效果。

descriptions.en-US: Powers up slicing moves.
descriptions.zh-CN: 提高切割类招式的威力。

descriptions.en-US: Attack and Special Attack are boosted for each party Pokémon that has been defeated.
descriptions.zh-CN: 队伍中每有一名已经倒下的成员，攻击和特攻就会提高。

descriptions.en-US: Copies ally's stat changes on entering battle.
descriptions.zh-CN: 出场时会复制同伴的能力变化。

descriptions.en-US: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
descriptions.zh-CN: 受到物理招式伤害时，会在对手一侧撒下毒刺。

descriptions.en-US: Prevents the opponent from using any moves that have priority, such as Quick Attack.
descriptions.zh-CN: 阻止对手对自己或同伴使用具有正优先级的招式。

descriptions.en-US: Restores HP when hit by a Ground-type move.
descriptions.zh-CN: 受到地面属性招式攻击时不会受伤，反而回复生命。

descriptions.en-US: Status moves go last, but are not affected by the opponent's ability.
descriptions.zh-CN: 变化招式总是最后行动，但使用时不受目标特性影响。

descriptions.en-US: Once per battle, when a Pokémon with Supersweet Syrup enters the battle, it lowers the evasion stat of all adjacent opponents by one stage.
descriptions.zh-CN: 每场战斗首次出场时，使对手的闪避率降低一级。

descriptions.en-US: When a Pokémon with Hospitality enters a battle, it restores HP for an ally by 25%.
descriptions.zh-CN: 出场时回复同伴四分之一的最大生命。

descriptions.en-US: May cause bad poisoning when the Pokémon hits an opponent with a move.
descriptions.zh-CN: 自己的招式命中对手时，有时会使其陷入剧毒状态。

descriptions.en-US: When Terapagos enters the battle, it turns into its Terastal Form until the end of the battle.
descriptions.zh-CN: 太乐巴戈斯出场时会变为太晶形态，并维持到战斗结束。

descriptions.en-US: Pokémon poisoned by Pecharunt's moves will also become confused.
descriptions.zh-CN: 被桃歹郎的招式施加中毒或剧毒时，目标也会陷入混乱。

descriptions.en-US: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves.
descriptions.zh-CN: 使用接触类招式时，可以命中处于守护状态的目标。

descriptions.en-US: The Pokémon's Normal-type moves become Dragon-type moves and their power is boosted by 20%.
descriptions.zh-CN: 一般属性招式会变为龙属性，并且威力提高百分之二十。

descriptions.en-US: The Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
descriptions.zh-CN: 即使当前不是晴天，也能让自己的招式按晴天状态结算。

descriptions.en-US: When the Pokémon takes damage from a move, it burns the attacker.
descriptions.zh-CN: 受到招式伤害时，会使攻击者陷入灼伤状态。

descriptions.en-US: The Pokémon floats off the ground, making it immune to Ground-type moves, as well as the Spikes, Toxic Spikes, and Sticky Web statuses. When the Pokémon knocks out a target with an attack, its highest stat is boosted by 1 stage.
descriptions.zh-CN: 不会处于地面，因此免疫地面招式和地面陷阱；击倒目标后提高自身数值最高的能力。

descriptions.en-US: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's Fire-type moves by 50%.
descriptions.zh-CN: 火属性招式的威力提高百分之五十。
